method: Roast rice in ghee until golden brown on low flame.
Wash roasted rice and cook in 3/4 cup water until soft.
Add milk 2 cups at a time, stirring until reduced.
Continue until all 8 cups of milk are used and reduced to about 5 cups.
Add sugar and powdered cashew nuts; cook for 5 minutes.
Garnish with chopped pistachios, roasted cashews, saffron, and cardamom powder.
notes: Note: This makes approximately 5 cups of payasam.
